t: Shake out the bed first, then say it
a: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبِّي بِكَ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
p: Subḥānaka-Llāhumma rabbī, bika waḍaʿtu janbī wa bika arfaʿuh. In amsakta nafsī fa-ghfir lahā, wa in arsaltahā fa-ḥfaẓhā bimā taḥfaẓu bihi ʿibādaka-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn
m: Glory to You, O Allah my Lord. By You I have laid down my side and by You I raise it. If You keep my soul, forgive it. And if You send it back, guard it with what You use to guard Your righteous servants.
